# `⊖` — Reverse / Rotate first

Keys: `Alt-o Minus`. Ranks: `∞` monadic, `∞ ∞` dyadic

First-axis forms of [`⌽`](reverse.qmd). `⊖⍠K` overrides the axis.

```bpl
⊖2 3⍴⍳6            ⍝ [3 4 5 ⋄ 0 1 2]
1⊖3 2⍴⍳6           ⍝ [2 3 ⋄ 4 5 ⋄ 0 1]
```

## Inverse

`⊖⁻¹Y` is `⊖Y`. `X⊖⁻¹Y` rotates `Y` back by `X`.

```bpl
1⊖⁻¹[3 4 ⋄ 1 2]   ⍝ [1 2 ⋄ 3 4]
```
